boards.school_name: North Carolina State University at Raleigh
boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented, no-admission activities on and near NC State, with optional purchases excluded from the plan.

cards.title: Walk the JC Raulston Arboretum
cards.subtitle: Public garden at NC State, 4415 Beryl Road
cards.notes: Meet at the visitor center, then take a slow loop through the plant collections; bring water and follow garden rules while you explore.
cards.short_summary: A year-round garden walk with no admission charge.
cards.evidence_claim: The JC Raulston Arboretum is open to the public year-round at no cost.
cards.access_notes: Public access; check the visitor-information page for seasonal garden hours and occasional event closures.

cards.title: Join the Sunday garden tour
cards.subtitle: Bobby G. Wilder Visitor Center, JC Raulston Arboretum
cards.notes: Arrive at the visitor center before 2 p.m. and join the volunteer docent for a one-hour walk through the garden’s collections.
cards.short_summary: A free, public guided introduction to the Arboretum.
cards.evidence_claim: Volunteer-led Sunday tours are available to the public free of charge at 2 p.m. from March through October.
cards.access_notes: Sundays at 2 p.m., March–October; no advance registration is available. Meet at the visitor center.

cards.title: Browse the People’s Collection
cards.subtitle: NC Museum of Art, East and West buildings
cards.notes: Pick a gallery wing, compare a few works at your own pace, and skip ticketed special exhibitions to keep the visit completely free.
cards.short_summary: Free access to NCMA’s permanent collection galleries.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission to the People’s Collection in the NCMA East and West buildings is free.
cards.access_notes: Galleries are open Wednesday–Sunday, 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; special exhibitions can require a paid ticket.

cards.entity_name: Ann and Jim Goodnight Museum Park
cards.title: Walk art trails at Museum Park
cards.subtitle: NC Museum of Art, 2110 Blue Ridge Road
cards.notes: Start at the Welcome Center, choose a trail, and pause at outdoor installations; stay on open paths and plan to finish before dusk.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor art-and-nature walk beside NC State.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ann and Jim Goodnight Museum Park is free and open daily, including holidays, from dawn to dusk.
cards.access_notes: Public park access is free from dawn to dusk; check the trail-closures notice before leaving.

cards.title: Take an NCMA guided park walk
cards.subtitle: Ann and Jim Goodnight Museum Park
cards.notes: Reserve a spot for an available themed walk, then meet ready to cover the park on foot while discussing art, nature, or sustainability.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled, no-cost guided walk through Museum Park.
cards.evidence_claim: NCMA’s guided Museum Park tours are free, though space is limited and preregistration is required.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled monthly in April, May, June, September, October, and November; preregistration is required and tours are for ages 12+.

cards.entity_name: North Carolina Museum of Natural Sciences
cards.title: Explore the science museum
cards.subtitle: Downtown Raleigh, 11 West Jones Street
cards.notes: Choose a few exhibit floors, compare notes on a favorite specimen or display, and avoid paid 3D films or special exhibitions.
cards.short_summary: A free downtown museum visit centered on natural science.
cards.evidence_claim: The North Carolina Museum of Natural Sciences offers free general admission.
cards.source_title: Hours & Admission — North Carolina Museum of Natural Sciences
cards.access_notes: Downtown museum hours are Monday–Sunday, 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; verify listed holiday closures before visiting.

cards.title: Catch a Pullen Park concert
cards.subtitle: Pullen Park event lawn, 520 Ashe Avenue
cards.notes: Bring a blanket or chair and settle in for the outdoor set; skip café purchases and check the city listing for weather changes.
cards.short_summary: A current free summer music series at Pullen Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Raleigh’s 2026 Pullen and Fletcher Park Summer Concert Series is free, with Pullen Park dates listed through August 16.
cards.source_title: 2026 Summer Concert Series — City of Raleigh
cards.access_notes: Select Sunday evenings, 6–8 p.m.; this seasonal series may change or be canceled, so confirm the current listing first.

cards.title: Bring a blanket for Pullen movie night
cards.subtitle: Pullen Park event lawn, 520 Ashe Avenue
cards.notes: Bring a lawn chair or blanket, arrive before the screening, and enjoy the outdoor film without buying refreshments from the café.
cards.short_summary: Free outdoor movie screenings scheduled through October.
cards.evidence_claim: Pullen Park Movie Series screenings are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Movie Series at Pullen Park — City of Raleigh
cards.access_notes: First Tuesday of each month through October; screenings are weather-dependent and the city posts cancellation updates.

cards.entity_name: D. H. Hill Jr. Library Exhibit Gallery
cards.title: See the D. H. Hill exhibit gallery
cards.subtitle: D. H. Hill Jr. Library, 2 Broughton Drive
cards.notes: Meet in the east-wing gallery, read the exhibit labels together, and use the library’s current-hours page before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A campus exhibition stop with publicly accessible displays.
cards.evidence_claim: NC State Libraries’ east-wing D. H. Hill exhibit gallery presents ongoing exhibitions that are free of charge and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Exhibit Program Guidelines — NC State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Open during D. H. Hill Jr. Library hours, with occasional closures for installation or maintenance.

cards.title: Browse Hunt Library’s exhibit spaces
cards.subtitle: James B. Hunt Jr. Library, 1070 Partners Way
cards.notes: Choose a display wall or physical exhibit space, take time with the work, and check building access information before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A public-facing NC State library stop for rotating displays.
cards.evidence_claim: NC State University Libraries states that its buildings and physical and digital exhibit spaces are open to the public every day.
cards.source_title: Strategic Priorities — NC State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Public exhibit access is described by the Libraries; consult current building hours before visiting.
